metaTitle.context: Page title shown in search results. It must be at most 44 characters in the target language, because the site name is appended after it. Write a short, natural title rather than a literal translation; drop filler words before meaning. Keep product names such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Cursor unchanged.

metaDescription.context: Meta description shown under the title in search results. It must be at most 155 characters in the target language. Condense rather than translate word for word: keep the main benefit and the product names, and drop secondary phrases before exceeding the limit.
